meta.title: Steward · long-lived engineering team
meta.description: Multi-role engineering team for DSH: the lead agent acts as Tech Lead, decomposes the request into a task DAG and dispatches specialist subagents (pm / architect / backend-dev / frontend-dev / qa-engineer / browser-tester / reviewer), with a plan approval gate, bug track, maintenance loop and trusted-change gates; roles are charters injected at dispatch time (no agent presets, so the mode picker stays clean), per-role model routes live in the project steward.config.json (editable in the Settings → Steward table; the project file wins), and the board is the Agent Teams shared board. The UI is a per-session right-sidebar board: dependency graph / task list / ownership matrix, live subagents (click a row for its child session), and the artifacts under tmp/steward/; task sources fall back shared board > run.json > todo list, opened from the session-header icon and automatically on the first dispatch. The per-role model + effort table is in Settings → Steward.
